summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX Appendix 2A seeking quotation of 255,830 ordinary shares issued at USD 6.00 per share. The shares were issued to settle Piedmont Equity Awards vested and exercised under the Merger Agreement announced previously, reflecting a routine post-merger share settlement. The filing is a standard listing application and does not constitute a standalone special situation transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or material structural changes are mentioned.
